author: Totally Not Mark
description:
DBS Beerus' animation fixes are very welcome, but cutting 41 episodes down to 19 concerns me. Can they pull that off without cutting the good stuff? And what even is the good stuff and do they have room expand on Super Saiyan God and Super Saiyan Blue? I sure hope so!

title: Half of Dragon Ball Super is Being CUT!?
